events.text: my burgers came super late and the app lied about it being delivered

I'm sorry about that, and I'll look into it. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me:

1. The full name on your account
2. The email address or phone number on the account

If you have your order number handy, please share that too.
Sure. It's Leo Brandt, and the phone on the account is 415-555-0232. The order number is 7201.

events.note: Courier app marked delivered 2.1 miles from the address

events.text:
Thanks, Leo. I've verified your account and looked into order Q-7201 from Burger Barn.

**What happened:**
- The order was promised for 7:00 PM.
- The courier picked it up at 6:40 PM.
- The handoff to you was recorded at 7:47 PM, 47 minutes after the promised time.
- The app also showed the order as delivered at 6:58 PM. That was logged by the courier's app while it was 2.1 miles from your address, so the status was wrong. The order wasn't handed to you until 7:47 PM.

**What I did:**
- I added a $5.60 account credit to your account. That is 20% of the $28.00 food subtotal, which is the compensation for a delivery more than 45 minutes late.

Credits can be used on future Forkful orders. The credit is not refunded to your card.

I can't refund the delivery fee, tip, or other charges, and I can't change the timing of the delivery. If you'd like, I can also tell you how to report anything else about this order.

Thanks for checking. I appreciate you finding the handoff time, but $5.60 in credit doesn't really cover it. I was home waiting for food that was promised at 7, and the app told me it had already been delivered. Nothing showed up until 7:45. I'd like a refund for the delivery fee and tip at least, since I paid for a delivery that was almost an hour late and the app was wrong about it.

I understand why you're frustrated. You waited at home for an order that was an hour late, and the app said it had been delivered when it hadn't.

I can't refund the delivery fee or tip, though. For late deliveries, our policy only allows account credit, and the amount is set by how late the order was. Order Q-7201 was 47 minutes late, so the $5.60 credit (20% of the $28.00 food subtotal) is the full compensation I'm able to offer for the delay. I'm not able to add more on top of it.

The $5.60 is already on your account and can be used on your next Forkful order. If you'd like to raise the wrong delivery status or anything else about this order with someone else, I can connect you with a human specialist. They'll follow up within 24 hours. Would you like me to do that?

Not really, no. $5.60 credit for an order that was almost an hour late and the app said was delivered when it wasn't is a joke. I'm not going to use credit on another order from you guys after this either.

I'd like the delivery fee and tip refunded to my card. If that's not something you can do, I'll take it up with someone who can. Can you tell me if there's a way to escalate this to a manager?

args.summary: Customer Leo Brandt (D202) asked to speak to a manager about order Q-7201 (Burger Barn). Promised 7:00 PM, picked up 6:40 PM, app marked delivered at 6:58 PM while courier was 2.1 miles away, actual in-person handoff at 7:47 PM (47 min late). Already issued $5.60 late-delivery credit (20% of $28.00 subtotal). Customer wants the $3.49 delivery fee and $3.00 tip refunded to the card, which policy does not allow for late deliveries. Customer is dissatisfied and says they will not use account credit again.

events.text:
I've passed your request to a human specialist, and they'll follow up within 24 hours. Your reference number is ESC-700. I've included everything we discussed: the late handoff, the app marking the order delivered while the courier was 2.1 miles away, and your request for a refund of the $3.49 delivery fee and $3.00 tip.

I can't promise what they'll decide. I also can't issue the refund myself, because our policy only allows account credit for late deliveries. The $5.60 credit remains on your account.

I'm sorry the order was so late and that the app showed the wrong status. Thanks for your patience, Leo.

Fine. ESC-700, got it. You've got the right details at least, the handoff time and the fact the app said delivered when the courier was still miles away. Let's see what the specialist says.

The $5.60 credit is not what I'm after, and I won't be ordering from Forkful again if this doesn't get sorted. Thanks for passing it on.

events.note: Courier app marked delivered 2.1 miles from the address
